newsitem.title: HAITI: Forty reported dead after windstorm in Haiti.
newsitem.headline: Forty reported dead after windstorm in Haiti.

text.p: Forty people were killed on Tuesday night when strong winds blew down 23 houses in Baie de Henne, a village on Haiti's northwestern coast, independent Radio Haiti Inter reported on Wednesday.

Haitian government and United Nations officials said they were aware of the reports but had no independent knowledge of the disaster. "At this point, we are not doing any rescue unless we receive a request from the government," said Eric Falt, a spokesman for the United Nations, whose peacekeeping troops are patrolling Haiti.
Haiti, the hemisphere's poorest nation, has bad communications and it often takes days for word of major disasters to reach the capital.
